response_texts: O little louse. You are past all prayers, aren't you? Mortals are truly nothing but lice.
It is foolish to submit to the maggots. So turn back. It is only a single step in vain.
Some day... I'll see you again, and I'll welcome you. To the place where the old wind blows, to the frozen castle in the forest...
What was the result of your negotiation with Arkved? Will he help us in Quagmire?
He's agreed to show us the way. He'll act as a landmark and guide to the dream teller.
That's oddly cooperative of him. What does he want in return?
He doesn't want anything. It confused me too when I asked him about it, but he said he already got the payment and that he wants to help us...
He's either crazy or trying to lure us into something... This witch hunt is getting more and more suspicious.
Arkved is insane, yes. He spends all his time singing now. I can't get him to answer any more questions.
So this is one of the ghouls that originated from the "baby"... Did you find out anything new by dissecting it?
No remarkable results were obtained from the ghoul post-mutation. The only thing I found out is that some of its internal organs were altered...
What was the mutation of the ghoul I caught last time like?
A string-like worm clung to the ghoul's organs. I transplanted it to a Skeever as a test... I could observe signs of ghouling after only a few hours.
Then that worm was carrying the "baby's" curse, right?
Most likely. I think those worms serve as the medium for dissemination of the curse to reshape the hosts' bodies. Watch out for string-like worms on the field.
My Lord, I see it now... I see now why the fires of your hope could not be extinguished even in the depths of the sea.
It must be the same as the impulse that drives me. You settled in like an ever-repeating thing, like fire sleeping beneath the earth.
Ghosts of Cuhlecain's cultists... Historical records show that Cuhlecain was assassinated by the Reachmen, an opposing force in the west at the time...
Romion, what do you think? Do you still believe that it was Talos who did it?
Talos was a cold-hearted person who wasn't picky about choosing his means to an end. I believe he wouldn't think twice about betraying even his king and friends.
You're very hard on Talos... I heard that the elves are very hostile to him, but I didn't think you'd be as well...
His time may be ancient history for the men, but not so for the elves. At least I have my own opinion about him...
Yes, not even the ghosts could forget the past... Or perhaps especially not the ghosts, since they're trapped in a memory.
It's not easy to forgive and forget. It's a very hard thing to do...
Look, look, a giant snail! This is the first time I've seen one so big!
A beehive! Bees go buzz-buzz.
Do you think these mushrooms are good to eat? I'd better not try...
There's a bird's nest on this tree. I found eggs inside when I climbed up. Don't steal them.
Here we are! My home is just beyond this door. And the big bad monster is in the way...
Just a moment, I'll give you the key. Now where is it...
The key... I lost it somewhere! What should I do?
This is bad, it's a beast-possessed soul! This is really bad, retreat!
Zuzu, please talk to us... What happened?
...No answer. Zuzu, I can't believe you're gone, too...
O Jhunal, God of Runes, punish the irreverent who follow the old covenant and approach the forbidden! Grant them eternal darkness!
Light creeps into a hidden place. The bird's thoughts turn wet and tainted in the rain.
They accumulate, logic dies and through its eyes you will learn the secrets of the soil.
Blood sprays in sunlight and dawn will trample over the wilderness.
Gahalma druhatar bahr iru... No sleep here, gahalma... Iru edur et solsif...
She lost her parents before she could even remember them, so she was taken in by my parents whom I was very close with. They raised her as if she was an elf.
Both of Lalanoah's parents were human, but when she grew, her ears became pointed like ours. As if she was imitating us...
I loved her too much to think it was creepy. Maybe because I spent so much time with her as if she was my own sister.
She lived very long. No matter how many years have passed, she always remained my little sister who adored me so... Until she fell in love.
When she was 200 years old, she got married to a Nord man. After she gave birth, she grew old as if time suddenly remembered her and she died...
My beloved sister left behind a daughter named Laelnoah. My beloved niece...
You have strayed from Ja'zel's path. Then he, too, must choose rougher methods, yes?
You do not learn from your mistakes, hmm? As it is, your path and Ja'zel's have diverged once more.
Ja'zel will repeat this as many times as needed until you are convinced. The key lies in choosing the path by your free will, yes?
This one will now reveal the name of the one unseen, for there is no more hope on this path.
The footprints of the Queen of Fates Unwritten still linger in Mundus. All lies shall be exposed.
The Prime Archon, the White Star that was lost and yet shines in the night sky.
Her name is...
Thus fell the Prince of Lyg. Black water gushed from his wounds like a flood and swallowed the land.
Once, Lorkh accompanied one of Magnus' daughters and together they traveled the endless worlds.
Sotha Sil gave birth to a daughter from a mechanical womb, and he named her Memory.
The dark swallowed even Y'ffre and devoured Unala-Se, the Unyielding Scion.
But at the far reaches of Lyg, she was left in the dark, so dark as to not be at all.
Of all the endless possibilities, she loved songs the most. Thus she collected the songs woven by mortals and recorded them in the Scrolls.
Even as she became a black tree of death and decay, she watched still, hoping we would remember Love.
The Black Star, Xero-Lyg, wandered beside the Serpent, and among the stars, she found paths yet unseen.
There is no right lesson learned alone. That is her teaching.
You are finally awake, yes? This is a hidden altar of the Snow Elves. It was difficult to bring you here.
Well then, forgive this one for waking you, but this is as far as you will go.
Well done, Ozwald. So here are the test results...
I know they're not good. Just say it. How much longer do I have?
I'd say three months at best... It's been progressing rapidly since Quagmire. I'm sure it's because of...
Enough. So how's the rookie doing?
Even worse than you, Ozwald, but something is healing the taint... I think your partner will be okay for a while still.
Huh, interesting. So how did the negotiations with your friend from High Rock go?
They are willing to help. Now all that's needed is a Red Drop.
We're going to get it next time. I'm sure of it.
Thank you... Ja'zel is very grateful. This one owes it all to you.
What's this rusty sword? Is it worth anything?
Are you blind? It's the ancient sword of St. Jiub.
St. Jiub? The one who exterminated all the cliff racers? Yeah, it would be great if that was the real sword. How do you know it's not a fake?
It's a genuine artifact, found in the burning remains of Kvatch. I even have a certificate.
Unbelievable. The legend says Jiub could wave with this sword and the clouds would break. Could it be true?
Perhaps. But don't swing that sword in here or the store will be blown away.
So, how much does the sword cost? About 100 gold?
It's a legendary artifact. 100 000 gold. No discounts.
What? That's too expensive. Who'd even buy it at such a price?
It's for attracting customers. I don't really want to sell it in the first place.
What a creepy vase... What is this?
Vase of Sheogorath. It grows different plants and fruit every day. Grapes yesterday, apples today.
Hmm, interesting... But gardening is not really my hobby.
The older you become, the more you respect the virtue of gardening. Ah, but you're still just an ignorant child.
No. I'm not going to react to such a cheap provocation. I'm not a kid.
...You got soft, Brandt. What happened?
There were many things. So many... But true Nords don't talk much about it.
The child was an orphan, whom my friend cared for. She was a lovely girl with a bright smile, and she didn't belong in a city full of slavers.
I was bad at my job. Because of this they killed my friend and made me eat him as my punishment... I never told her. She loved her friend.
Sometime after my friend was gone, she started singing her mother's song at night. I don't know where she learned it... perhaps she wanted revenge.
So I wanted revenge, too. Because I loved her. She was just like a child of my own...
Activate all heavily armored automatons. Place them on the routes leading to the Dream Engine Room.
The intruders' aim is probably "her". Keep them away from the Dream Engine Room! Stop them!
